meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: 它先用回归测试把现有行为锁住,再按类别清理分支改动或指定文件里的 AI 生成代码坏味道(如明显注释、过度防御、无用抽象等),最后用质量门禁和评审验证;验证不过就回滚或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或去除最近改动里的 AI-slop 时触发。默认范围是当前分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可由调用方传入明确的文件列表。

say.text: 帮我清理这次分支改动里的 AI 代码坏味道
say.note: 会先补回归测试再动手

say.text: 把 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 去一下 slop
say.note: 以这两个文件为清理范围

say.text: 这段改动里的明显注释和过度防御帮我清掉

howto.what_en: Locks behavior with regression tests, cleans AI-generated code smells from branch changes or a given file list, then verifies with quality gates and review — reverting or direct-editing when verification fails.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main; a caller may pass an explicit file list.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in src/foo.py and src/bar.py.
Remove obvious comments and over-defensive code here.
